fields.description: Issue includes editorial and commentary on Florida state taxation and Dade County’s financial contributions to the state, with discussion of Tallahassee politics and local patronage. Reports on a criminal libel case involving Miami Life staff and references to court proceedings and local political figures. Contains extensive local advertising and nightlife/entertainment listings, horse-racing coverage and promotions (including Tropical Park), and a prominent National Recovery Administration (NRA) plumbers’ code compliance endorsement listing Miami-area plumbing firms.
